description: One row per customer account. A customer belongs to exactly one tenant (business) and can place many orders.

columns.name: signup_date
columns.description: Date the customer created their account

ddl:
CREATE TABLE text_to_sql_node.customers (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  tenant_id UUID NOT NULL,
  full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  email TEXT NOT NULL,
  signup_date DATE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE,
  loyalty_tier TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'bronze'
);
